name: Dusk CRT
notes: Single source of truth for the app, the video renderer and the style lab. Art sizes are in art pixels (px@art); everything else says its unit.

night.role: Outlines, deepest background, text on paper

twilight.role: Raised surfaces, desk front, swirl band

plum.role: Card backs, swirl band, secondary text on paper

heather.role: Swirl highlight, card-back pattern. Never text

lamp.role: Pet fur, primary accent, button face

ember.role: Tabby stripes, dog ears and patches, tail tip, button shadow. Never text on paper

teal.role: Swirl accent, holo shimmer, dog collar

paper.role: Card faces, pet belly, primary text on dark

parchment.role: Desk top, paw toes, secondary text on dark

smoke.role: Tertiary text on dark, disabled states

contrast.rule: Text needs 4.5:1 (WCAG AA). Checked pairs below, ratios computed with the WCAG formula.

unitPt.rule: 1 art pixel = an integer number of points or video pixels. Never scale art by a fraction.

grid.outline: 1 art px, color night, on every sprite and card
grid.corners: Stepped: notch 1 art px off each corner. No smooth border-radius inside the scene
grid.sampling: Nearest neighbor only. Art is drawn on the grid; motion may move it off the grid

sceneFont.name: Dusk 5x7
sceneFont.use: Labels inside the CRT scene: times, card titles, counters, buttons. 4 lines max per element

uiFont.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible
uiFont.use: Anything a person types or reads at length: task entry, settings, onboarding questions, VoiceOver-adjacent UI. Min 17 pt body

displayFont.name: Pixelify Sans
displayFont.use: Marketing headlines and App Store screenshots only

settle.use: Cards landing, drawer, panels moving into place

motion.skip: A tap anywhere during the sequence jumps to the final state

beats.what: Card 1 flips and files into the drawer
Screen shake, CRT pulse, laptop lid closes
Pet hops, curls up at the apex
Swirl winds down. Button reads SEE YOU TOMORROW

crt.rule: One brightness pulse per sequence, never more than 3 flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1)

accessibility: Reduce Motion on: no shake, no flicker, no flips, swirl frozen. Cards slide and fade instead
Every sprite-only control has a VoiceOver label. The scene itself is one image with a text summary
Sound is off by default. Haptics follow the system setting
The sequence is skippable with a tap and never blocks the next screen for more than 2.6 s
Text inside the scene stays under 4 lines per element; anything longer moves to Atkinson UI text
